# Microarchitecture Fundamentals

## Concepts

Datapaths, control, instruction execution, latency, throughput, and architectural state.

## Implementation

Connect a basic datapath and control unit, using CORE-V Wally as a reference for design choices.

## Hands-on Experiments

Trace instruction execution and measure the effects of simple microarchitectural changes.

For each experiment, record the tool versions, design configuration, commands, inputs, expected results, and observed results.
